vaultScreen.title: Vault
vaultScreen.lead: Your pulls live here first — a private, premium hold where you trade, list, ship later, or cash out. Converted hits stay in pull history only.
vaultScreen.benefit1: • Keep hits inside Pull Hub — build a real collection, not one-off shipments.
vaultScreen.benefit2: • Vault Exchange: friends see your whole Vault — request anything; only your listings get Buy now (card checkout).
vaultScreen.benefit3: • Request shipment on your schedule — fewer rushed labels, calmer fulfillment.
vaultScreen.benefit4: • Every secured item shows a clear storage timer so you always know what happens next.
vaultScreen.benefit5: • We’ll nudge you before time’s up — then unused items liquidate to credits automatically.
vaultScreen.benefitFine: Complimentary hold: {{days}} days per item. You can convert to credits anytime.
vaultScreen.emptyBody: Open packs on Packs — new hits land here secured, insured-feeling, and ready for what you do next.
vaultScreen.emptyFilterBody: Try another status tab or clear filters to see your full Vault.

wonPrizesModal.title: Cash out or Vault
wonPrizesModal.lead: By default every hit converts to credits as soon as you confirm. Check any row to secure it in the Vault instead — trade, list, or ship later. Shipping starts from the Vault when you’re ready.
wonPrizesModal.summaryAllVault: Everything here is headed to your Vault with a {{days}}-day complimentary hold. No credits until you convert from Vault or the hold ends.
wonPrizesModal.summaryAllConvert: You’re cashing the full batch to credits — credits land as soon as you confirm.
wonPrizesModal.summaryMixed: Unchecked rows convert to credits on confirm. Checked rows stay in your Vault for {{days}} days.
wonPrizesModal.checkboxHint: Default: converts to credits when you confirm. Checked rows go to your Vault instead.
wonPrizesModal.confirmBody: We’ll credit your wallet immediately for every row converting to credits. Vault rows stay secured.

membership.heroLead: A monthly pass for collectors — coins, status, and curated access to member-only packs and drops. Not a one-off coin bundle.
membership.valueBlockBody: Your tier unlocks a badge, monthly coins, exclusive pack lanes, and earlier windows on select drops — the same rhythm serious collectors expect from a premium Oripa experience.

helpCenter.lead: Quick answers for credits, shipping, and drops. This is sample content — replace with your real help articles before launch.

credits.a: Credits are the in-app currency used to open digital packs. Purchases in this preview may be simulated — final pricing, refunds, and bundles will be published before launch.

shipping.q: Where do you ship physical cards?
shipping.a: Marketplace orders ship from partner stores. Cutoffs, carriers, and fees vary by listing. Add a shipping address in Account so checkout is faster when payments go live.

drops.a: Hot drops are limited-time or high-demand pack releases. They are different from account promos (bonuses and coupons). Tap Hot Drops on Account for a short explainer.

deleteAccount.lead: Permanently deletes your Pull Hub account with our sign-in provider and clears local data on this device. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.confirmBody: Your Clerk account will be deleted and local vault/history on this device will be cleared. Language and preference toggles stay on the device.
deleteAccount.doneBody: Your account has been removed. You can create a new one anytime.
deleteAccount.errorBody: Something went wrong. Try again or contact support.
deleteAccount.localLead: You’re browsing without a cloud account. This clears local vault, friends, and onboarding data on this device.
deleteAccount.localConfirmBody: Removes guest session data and vault history on this device. Preferences like language and sound stay.
deleteAccount.localDoneBody: This device is reset to a fresh guest session.

hotDropsInfo.body: Hot drops are time-limited or high-demand pack releases — often a specific set, collab, or flash window. They are about the product and timing.
hotDropsInfo.b1: Announced start and end times (or “while supplies last”).
hotDropsInfo.b2: May have different odds or price than evergreen packs — always read the pack details.
hotDropsInfo.b3: Can sell out quickly; enabling notifications helps you catch restocks.
hotDropsInfo.callout: Not the same as Promos: promos are marketing incentives (bonus credits, coupons), not the pack release itself.

promosInfo.body: Promos are marketing programs: bonus credits, coupon codes, seasonal campaigns, or partner offers. They reward actions like signing up, buying bundles, or referring friends.
promosInfo.b1: Shown in-app, email, or social — each promo has its own rules and dates.
promosInfo.b2: May stack with tiers or be limited to certain packs — read the fine print before launch.
promosInfo.b3: Different from Hot Drops: a promo is the offer; a hot drop is the product release.
promosInfo.vsHotBody: Use Hot Drops to learn about limited pack releases. Use Promos (this screen) to understand bonus credits and coupon-style incentives.

pullHistoryScreen.lead: Every completed play — newest first. Pending pulls stay in the pack flow until you cash out or ship.

linkedAccounts.body: Linking extra sign-in methods to one Pull Hub profile is not available yet. Nothing on this screen can connect Google, Apple, or email today.
linkedAccounts.whatBody: It is not about merging two separate app accounts. It is about attaching sign-in providers to one account for convenience and recovery.
linkedAccounts.note: Provider linking will use your auth settings (e.g. Clerk) when this feature ships. No action is required here.

identityVerification.body: Identity verification (KYC) is not active in this build. You cannot submit an ID or complete verification from this screen.
identityVerification.whyBody: It reduces fraud, protects minors, and satisfies financial or marketplace rules when money or valuable prizes move between users and platforms.
identityVerification.note: We’ll enable a real vendor (e.g. Persona, Stripe Identity) before requiring verification for payouts or regulated features.

payoutMethod.body: Bank and debit payouts are not connected yet. You cannot add a payout method or receive cash-outs from this screen.
payoutMethod.line1: Add a bank account (ACH / local rails) or debit card depending on region.
payoutMethod.line2: Verify small deposits or instant micro-charges when your processor requires it.
payoutMethod.line3: Payout timing and fees will follow marketplace rules — see Terms before launch.
payoutMethod.note: Real payout onboarding arrives with Stripe Connect (or your PSP). Until then, this page is informational only.
